jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.

A completed vocational qualification is preferred. Wat bieden wij je? As a Cleaning Operator, you will work in a high-tech production environment in Eindhoven, where industrial packaging and transport boxes are cleaned, inspected, and prepared for reuse. This is a full-time position in a 2-shift schedule within an international organization with long-term career opportunities.

- Removing labels, contamination, and transport damage from packaging.
- Cleaning and packing packaging materials and components.

- Experience operating an EPT or stacker.

jobs.occupation: Strategic Air Cargo Controller (3+ Years Experience)
jobs.description:
In this high-stakes role, you are the backbone of the air cargo supply chain, where every minute and every document counts. Your day is defined by the high pressure of flight schedules and the absolute necessity for precision in handling complex shipments. You don't just move boxes; you manage the integrity of international trade by ensuring all cargo is cleared, secured, and palletized according to strict aviation standards. You operate with a deep understanding of the logistical flow and are capable of making split-second decisions to prevent delays in global transport.

Tasks
 - Orchestrating the full handling cycle of air freight shipments under strict deadlines.
 - Verifying and managing complex airway bills, customs declarations, and manifests.
 - Supervising the technical build-up of ULDs to maximize flight capacity and safety.
 - Conducting rigorous security screenings in compliance with aviation law.
 - Managing the logistics of specialized cargo, including perishables and high-value goods.
 - Interfacing directly with ground handlers and airline representatives to optimize transit.
 - Monitoring and reporting on shipment status within advanced air cargo WMS platforms.

We are looking for
 - A minimum of 3 years of verifiable experience specifically within the air freight industry.
 - Possession of a valid "Medewerker Luchtvracht" or "Beveiligingsadviseur Luchtvracht" certificate.
 - Expert knowledge of IATA regulations and international customs procedures.
 - Proven ability to operate effectively in a high-pressure, time-critical environment.
 - Fluency in English is mandatory; professional proficiency in Dutch is highly preferred.
 - A proactive attitude and the ability to pass a rigorous background check (VGB).

We offer
 - Competitive salary reflective of your specialized expertise.
 - Travel allowance for all work-related commuting.
 - Holiday pay and paid vacation days.
 - Flexible payment options via Staffice.
 - Dedicated career guidance
